params.description: The name of the recovery services vault.

params.name: resourceGroupName
params.description: The name of the resource group where the recovery services vault is present.

params.name: fabricName
params.description: Fabric name associated with the backup item.

params.name: containerName
params.description: Container name associated with the backup item.

params.name: protectedItemName
params.description: Backup item name whose details are to be fetched.

params.name: operationId
params.description: OperationID represents the operation whose status needs to be fetched.

items.docs:
Fetches the status of an operation such as triggering a backup, restore. The status can be in progress, completed
or failed. You can refer to the OperationStatus enum for all the possible states of the operation. Some operations
create jobs. This method returns the list of jobs associated with the operation.
